title: Lolo’s Patience Paid Off Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Lolo's Patience Paid Off is just steps to Ruskin Park, Seaside Ave, and the Beach. Incredible porches up and down and outdoor dining for four in fenced in back yard with grill! A prime location Seaside, FL family home.
description_expanded: Description169 EAST RUSKIN STREETKING, DOUBLE, 3 TWINS, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA - SLEEPS 9Central Seaside Location Near Ruskin Park & Seaside AvenueNestled on one of Seaside’s most peaceful and picturesque streets, Lolo’s Patience enjoys a premier central location just steps from iconic Ruskin Park and charming Seaside Avenue. This inviting home places you within a four-minute walk to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf and only moments from downtown Seaside’s beloved shops, cafés, and live entertainment—offering the perfect balance of convenience and tranquility.Classic Southern Welcome & Inviting Outdoor LivingArrival is effortless with a private driveway and designated parking directly in front of the home. From the moment you step onto the expansive screened front porch, you’ll feel the relaxed rhythm of Seaside living. Featuring a porch swing, four rocking chairs, and ceiling fans, this shaded retreat is ideal for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or winding down in the evening with good conversation.Open-Concept Living, Dining & KitchenInside, the main living level offers a warm, open-concept layout designed for gathering. The living room centers around a plush white sectional and a large mounted flat-screen TV—perfect for movie nights or relaxing after a beach day. Adjacent, the dining area features a wooden table with bench seating for eight, creating an inviting space for shared meals. The fully equipped kitchen provides ample counter space, generous cabinetry, and everything needed for anything from quick snacks to full family dinners.Private Backyard with Deck, Grill & Enclosed PorchJust beyond the main living area, a bright enclosed rear porch with bistro seating opens to a fully fenced backyard designed for effortless outdoor living. The spacious deck includes dining for four, Adirondack bar seating for two, and a charcoal grill—ideal for casual cookouts, sunset dinners, and evenings under the stars.First-Floor Guest Bedroom & Full BathThe first-floor guest bedroom features two twin beds, a flat-screen TV, and easy access to a full bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination—perfect for younger guests or flexible sleeping arrangements.Second-Floor Bonus Living Space & Screened PorchUpstairs, the landing doubles as a comfortable bonus living area with a queen sleeper sofa, large flat-screen TV, and access to a breezy screened porch overlooking the backyard greenery—an ideal hangout for kids or a quiet retreat.Additional Guest Bedroom with En-Suite BathJust off the landing is a cheerful guest bedroom offering one double bed and one twin bed, a flat-screen TV, and a private en-suite bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination—well-suited for children, teens, or additional guests.King Primary Suite with Private Screened PorchAt the end of the hall, the serene king primary suite serves as a true retreat. This light-filled space includes a generous sitting area, two closets, a large mounted flat-screen TV, and a spacious en-suite bathroom with dual vanities and a tub/shower combination. French doors open to a private screened porch lounge furnished with a sofa, club chairs, and soft ambient lighting—perfect for afternoon naps, evening wine, or quiet moments beneath the stars.A Relaxed Seaside Retreat for Family & FriendsWhether you’re gathering for family meals, enjoying beach days followed by backyard cookouts, or unwinding in one of the home’s many outdoor spaces, Lolo’s Patience offers the ideal blend of central Seaside convenience, coastal charm, and peaceful relaxation—all in the heart of Seaside, Florida.* 5-night minimum required in spring break and summer, 3-night minimum fall, 2 night winter. * Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESFeatures 1,862 square feet352 yards or a 4-minute walk to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach at East Ruskin Pavilion — the largest private beaches on 30APrivate outdoor showerCharcoal grillWasher & dryerPrivate driveway with parking for one vehicle, plus designated private parking in front of the home for a second vehiclePeacock Alley Linens — fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued — a golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001967
